objs = {
'2a': {(0,5),(1,5),(1,6)},
'2b': {(2,0),(3,0)},
'3': {(2,2),(2,3),(2,4)},
'4': {(3,4),(3,6),(4,4),(4,5),(4,6)},
'5': {(8,3),(8,4)},
'6': {(6,6),(7,6)},
}
fixed={(0,3),(5,3),(7,1),(9,5)}
# slide each object rightmost-first fully against stationary / already positioned objects
placed=[]
for name,cells in sorted(objs.items(), key=lambda kv:max(c for r,c in kv[1]), reverse=True):
    while True:
        nxt={(r,c+1) for r,c in cells}
        if any(c>=10 for r,c in nxt) or nxt & fixed or any(nxt & other for _,other in placed): break
        cells=nxt
    placed.append((name,cells))
    print(name, sorted(cells), 'shift', next(iter(cells))[1]-min(c for r,c in objs[name]))
grid=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
for r,c in fixed:grid[r][c]=8
for name,cells in placed:
    color=int(name[0])
    for r,c in cells:grid[r][c]=color
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
